title.rendered: PES 2018 PPSSPP Iso Download For Android

content.rendered:
Download PES 2018 PPSSPP iso latest version, which runs on Android phone or PSP Console.

Soccer game lovers who are still enjoying the previous year PES version will feel the urge to update to the current version of 2018.

The direct Apk version is still accessible on the Google play store, but below I have taking time to get the iso version for the PSP Emulator on Android device, as other blogs, failed to update there links even though the 2018 pes is still in high demand.

Some times back, the Pro Evolution Soccer team, released the demo version of PES 2018, which features usain bolt as a football player, however the game is still in development, but below I will provide the mod version.

You might need this PES related files for your device, suchs PES 2017 Iso, ppsspp-psp Gold Emulator Apk, they all support any Android phone.

Features Of PES 2018 PSP 

– Goal tactics and dribbling techniques has been updated.

– Ball passing accuracy received major improvement.

– Management of players is now easy and smooth from the game menu.

– Transfer of players from one team to another.

– WiFi connection mode for multiplayers

– Stadium upgrade now available after accumulating points.

– Best graphics to meet the current appearance of clubs, players, football kit, player hair styles etc.

– The Game is in offline mode.

 PES 2018 PPSSPP Iso Download

Download PES 2018 Iso Save Data Textures

What’s New (Updated January, 2019)

– New updates which includes player transfer and more

– Multilanguage (includes – English, Spanish, French etc.).

Pls. Note that the iso file is in zip or rar format, you will need to extract the file into a separate folder in which you can easily locate.

How To Install PES 2018 Game On Your PSP

1. Install the ppsspp Gold apk , which you can download Here>> PPSSPP Gold Emulator Apk

2. I believe you must have extract the game from the instructions I dropped above..

3. Goto to your file manager and locate PSP folder then extract the option files and textures you downloaded above into the folder or replace the save data. E.g sdcard/PSP/savedata

4. Open the psp app and select pes 2018 or 17.. icon from the folder you saved the iso file.

5. It is very important you to download textures, option file above which contains the latest transfer list, colors and many updates.. Those with 2017 English version of PES can only download the textures, continue reading below to see the proper guide to set up save data and textures.

How To Use Texture File And Savedata Or Option file

  1. Extract the option file First using Zarchiver pro Apk >>>
  2. Copy the save data to PSP folder e.g PSP/Save data
  3. Move the second file UCL… To PSP folder also or Generally extract all the texture file to PSP folder.

If you have any questions pls contact me or drop your comments below.
